sources.title: Annual Changes to the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index
sources.web_review_status: opened and relevant addition table read
sources.evidence: The exchange announces 100 additions and 16 annual-reconstitution removals, effective before the December 21, 2020 session. This is a dated change list, not the complete constituent basket or a continuous listing series.

sources.title: 2021 Year in Review, Part One: Swelling the Ranks of the Nasdaq Biotechnology Index
sources.evidence: Annual counts show 36 deletions during 2020, exceeding the 16 removals in the December 2020 annual notice. The difference demonstrates missing intra-year deletions if only annual notices are used.

sources.title: NBI weighting access page
sources.evidence: The public weighting page displays current-date index context and a login requirement for full data; no historic constituent file was returned.

sources.title: Nasdaq Global Index Watch
sources.evidence: The provider documents subscription access to historical components and corporate actions. No subscription was purchased or account created.
